audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: The analyst incorrectly reported the FY2018–FY2020 average capital expenditures as a percentage of revenue as 10.9%.
audit_report.reported_metric: FY2018–FY2020 three-year average capital expenditures as a percentage of revenue
audit_report.rationale: The extractor values imply annual capex-to-revenue ratios of approximately 12.6% (2018), 5.7% (2019), and 5.2% (2020), averaging about 7.9%, not 10.9%. The writer merely repeated the analyst's incorrect result.
